球球是大俠貓的徒弟。每次練習蜷縮，他總是縮到一半就歪倒。師父抱著胸，看得直笑，接: Qiuqiu is the Master's disciple. Every time he practices curling up, he always tips over halfway through. The Master crosses his arms, laughing at the sight, then demonstrates it again for him to copy.
那天夜裡，一縷紫色的魔氣飄進村裡，鑽入師父體內。師父痛苦地跪倒，眼睛變成了紫色；: That night, a wisp of purple miasma drifted into the village and sank into the Master. He fell to his knees in pain, his eyes turning purple; on the open ground outside the village, a magic tower rose up, floor by floor.
師父忽然起身，朝魔塔跑去。球球抓起藍頭巾追了出去，沒聽見師妹在身後叫他。等他跑到: The Master suddenly rose and ran toward the tower. Qiuqiu grabbed his blue headband and dashed after him, not hearing his junior sister calling behind him. By the time he reached the tower, he saw several monsters hauling the village's dried fish inside.
我要把師父帶回家，也要把村裡的小魚乾拿回來喵。: I'm going to bring the Master home, and get the village's dried fish back too, meow.
要切磋可以，先把路邊的東西挪開。: Fine, let's spar - but move that stuff off the road first.
刨夠了？我可不會站著讓你撞。: Done pawing at the ground? I'm not just standing here for you to charge.
紙邊也能割傷手，不能直接抓。: Even paper edges can cut. Can't just grab it bare-handed.
敲得這麼急，你自己跟得上嗎？: Beating that fast - can you even keep up with yourself?
這層鐵皮敲下去，手都要麻了。: One hit on that sheet metal and my hand goes numb.
絲別纏到扣帶上，等一下解不開。: Don't let that silk tangle my straps, or I'll never untie it.
腳步都歪了，拳頭倒還挺準。: Footwork's a mess, but the punches still land true.
原來是你在叫牠們。: So you're the one calling them over.
藏那麼遠，還扔得到？: Hiding that far away, and it still reaches me?
先別晃鏡子，我看得見你。: Stop waving that mirror - I can see you.
牠的身子都透光了……打得到嗎？: Its body's see-through... can I even hit it?
剛才誰把會動的東西擺上盤子？: Who put something that moves on a plate?
分開以後還會追人？: It splits apart and still chases me?
頭縮得真快。連腳都收進去了。: That head ducked fast. Even the feet pulled in.
下來一點。一直仰頭，脖子都痠了。: Come down a bit. My neck's sore from looking up.
這麼大的熊，我可搬不動。: A bear this big, I could never carry it.
還在鼓？我再退兩步。: Still puffing up? I'll back off two more steps.
這殼比護臂還厚。: That shell's thicker than my bracers.
前面排得整整齊齊，後面還有人指揮。: Lined up so neatly in front, and someone's directing from behind.
槍尖別亂晃，眼睛差點被你戳到。: Watch that spear tip - you almost poked my eye out.
你嘴裡在唸什麼？聽了就不舒服。: What are you muttering? Hearing it makes my skin crawl.
等一下，剛才牠還在那邊。: Wait, it was right there a second ago.
握那麼緊，手指不會痛嗎？: Gripping that tight - don't your fingers hurt?
這些粉別沾到臉上。: Don't let that powder get on my face.
石頭手掌……這一下不能硬吃。: A stone palm... can't take this one head-on.
池子也是你的，樓梯也是你的？: The pond's yours too? And the stairs?
這些小兵連武器都快舉不住了。: These grunts can barely hold their weapons up.
整條路都被殼堵住了。: The whole road's blocked by that shell.
鼻子冒煙了。牠睡著也這麼燙？: Smoke from its nose. Is it this hot even asleep?
眼睛都紫了，您還認得人嗎？: Your eyes have gone purple. Do you still know who I am?
刀先收回去，話還沒說完。: Put the blade away - I'm not done talking.
弦沒斷，我耳朵倒快受不了了。: The string didn't snap, but my ears nearly did.
燈籠也有舌頭？難怪一直漏風。: A lantern with a tongue? No wonder it keeps whistling.
這聲音……靠這麼近，真受不了。: That sound... this close, it's unbearable.
這麼小就出來攔路，誰叫你來的？: So small, and already out here blocking the road - who sent you?
少了一隻還跳得這麼快？: Missing a leg and still hopping that fast?
墨還在滴。腳下全黑了。: Ink's still dripping. The ground's all black underfoot.
你拿那把槌子，是來搗東西還是打架？: That mallet you're holding - are you here to pound rice or to fight?
頭轉到後面，身子不用跟著轉？: Head turned all the way around, and the body doesn't follow?
紙折得這麼薄，邊緣跟刀一樣利。: Folded that thin, and the edge cuts like a blade.
裡面那張臉，是活的嗎？: That face inside - is it alive?
站在暗處，我差點撞上你。: Standing in the shadows - I nearly ran into you.
一條腿也站得這麼穩？: Standing that steady on one leg?
頭上的水快灑出來了。: The water on its head is about to spill.
這味道不對，別再往我這邊遞了。: That smell's off - stop passing it my way.
風把工具袋都掀開了！: The wind blew my tool bag wide open!
你拿著符往我這邊走做什麼？: Why are you walking my way with that talisman?
空盔甲怎麼自己站起來了？: How's an empty suit of armor standing up on its own?
這不是球球。他的影子不會自己跑。: That's not Qiuqiu. His shadow doesn't move on its own.
鏡子裡的影子走出來了。: The shadow in the mirror just stepped out.
說好切磋，你也要上？: We agreed to spar - you're jumping in too?
那幾桶小魚乾，全被你搬來了？: Those barrels of dried fish - you hauled them all here?
站得高也不用把整條路擋住。: Standing up high doesn't mean you get to block the whole road.
酒離我遠點，聞著都嗆。: Keep that liquor away - the smell alone stings.
來的人不少。到底是誰要跟我打？: Quite a crowd. So who exactly is fighting me?
袖子挽得這麼整齊，是早就等著了？: Sleeves rolled up so neat - you were waiting for me, weren't you?
你也要攔我？托盤先放下吧。: You're stopping me too? Put the tray down first.
糧箱上的牙印，是你們啃的吧？: Those bite marks on the grain box - that was you, wasn't it?
地上都是醬油，腳都站不穩了。: Soy sauce all over the floor - I can barely keep my footing.
我差點伸手去掀蓋子。: I almost reached out to lift the lid.
這身刺，連碰都不能碰。: All those spines - can't even touch it.
又滿了？這罐頭從哪裡補進去的？: Full again? Where does this can keep getting refilled from?
一隻一隻來，我看不清你的手。: One at a time - I can't keep track of your hands.
睡在這裡，不怕別人踩到？: Sleeping right here - not afraid someone'll step on you?
把手從我的袋子拿開。: Get your hands off my bag.
小隻的也會偷，果然是一夥的。: Even the small one steals - so you're all in it together.
我抬手你也抬，那我不動呢？: I raise my hand, you raise yours - what if I don't move at all?
底下這麼多腳，難怪掃得快。: So many legs underneath - no wonder it sweeps fast.
石座空了……原來你走下來了。: The stone pedestal's empty... so you climbed down.
這味道太濃，得換口氣。: That smell's too strong - I need some fresh air.
別撞我的腳，我又不是地上的垃圾。: Don't bump into my feet - I'm not trash on the ground.
連小掃把都跟來了。: Even the little broom came along.
您這個站姿，一看就練了很多年。: That stance of yours - clearly years of practice.
影子裡還藏著一隻。: There's another one hiding in the shadow.
這隻一直不動，在等什麼？: This one hasn't moved at all - what's it waiting for?
底座做得不錯，比村裡那根還牢靠。: Nice sturdy base - more solid than the one back in the village.
婆婆，您的尾巴碰到我了。: Granny, your tail just touched me.
尾巴還能自己追過來？: The tail can chase after me on its own?
這些爪子一合起來，護臂都會被夾扁。: If those claws close together, they'd crush my bracers flat.
飯糰長腳，我還是第一次見。: A rice ball with legs - first time I've seen that.
這木頭關節，怎麼自己動起來了？: How are these wooden joints moving on their own?
你也走錯路了？出口在下面。: You got lost too? The exit's downstairs.
這麼吵，開關在哪裡？: So noisy - where's the off switch?
堵在門口，是在等我？: Blocking the doorway - waiting for me?
要東西就好好說，爪子先收起來。: If you want something, just ask - put the claws away first.
稻草紮得挺緊，還會拿武器。: Bundled that tight, and it can still hold a weapon.
好快，差點沒接住。: That's fast - I almost didn't catch it.
這麼大根，門都快擠不下了。: That big, it barely fits through the door.
你就是叫牠們守在下面的那隻？: So you're the one who told them to guard down there?
這個要是往下滾，整條樓梯都會被堵住。: If this rolls down, it'll block the whole staircase.
你後面還有人？別往前擠。: There's more behind you? Don't push forward.
大俠貓，您看我一眼。: Master, look at me - just once.
冷得手指都僵了。: So cold my fingers have gone stiff.
一直招手，也不代表我會掏錢。: Waving me over doesn't mean I'll pay up.
光照在前面，嘴藏在後面。好險。: Light's out front, mouth's hiding behind. That was close.
線連到後面去了。原來是你在拉。: The string runs back there. So you're the one pulling it.
木頭做的，打下來可不輕。: It's made of wood - coming down, it's no light hit.
還喝？你都快站不住了。: Still drinking? You can barely stand.
這盞一亮，那盞也亮了。: This one lights up, and that one follows.
得留意另一盞，別只顧眼前。: Watch the other lantern too - don't just focus on this one.
太多了，頭上全是翅膀！: Too many! My head's covered in wings!
聲音在盔甲裡，裡面卻沒人。: The voice is inside the armor, but there's no one in there.
兩張嘴，一張咬這邊，一張咬那邊。: Two mouths - one bites this side, one bites that side.
石像也攔在最後一段樓梯上。: Even a stone statue blocks the last flight of stairs.
又換面具。這次手勢也變了。: Another mask change. The gestures shifted too, this time.
你都擺好架勢了……看來不是問路就能過去。: You've already taken your stance... guess asking for directions won't cut it.
牠刨地刨得好用力，鼻子還朝著我。這是要衝過來嗎？: It's pawing the ground hard, nose pointed right at me. Is it about to charge?
遠看像紙做的，近看全是尖角。被劃到可不是鬧著玩的。: Looks like paper from afar, but up close it's all sharp corners. Getting cut isn't a joke.
鼓聲越來越急了。我連自己的心跳都聽不見。: The drumbeat's getting faster. I can't even hear my own heartbeat over it.
鐵皮底下還有關節在動。原來不是一整塊鐵。: There are joints moving under the sheet metal. So it's not one solid piece after all.
絲都纏到手上了！這樣叫我怎麼拿針。: The silk's all tangled around my hand! How am I supposed to hold my needle like this?
站都站不穩，怎麼還能出拳？不能跟著牠的腳步晃。: It can barely stand, so how's it still throwing punches? I can't let its wobbling throw off my footing.
小鬼都在等牠點頭……原來是牠叫你們攔我的。: The little ones are all waiting for its nod... so it's the one who told you to stop me.
這幾隻一直互相看，不能只盯住一隻。: These ones keep glancing at each other - I can't just watch one of them.
鏡子裡全是我的臉，我都快分不清出口了。: The mirrors are all showing my face - I can barely tell which way is out anymore.
碎成這樣還會動？我不要踩到那些碎片。: Broken like this and it still moves? I'd better not step on the shards.
剛剛還看得見，現在又只剩影子。牠究竟站在哪裡？: It was visible a moment ago, and now there's just a shadow left. Where is it even standing?
我差點以為是點心。牠剛才是不是看了我一眼？: I almost mistook it for a snack. Did it just glance at me?
又分開了！大的小的都別往鞋子裡鑽。: It split again! Big or small, none of you are crawling into my shoes.
縮得只剩一個殼。你害怕，我也害怕呀。: Curled up into nothing but a shell. You're scared - well, so am I.
翅膀一直晃，我得看清牠停在哪裡。: Its wings keep flickering - I need to see exactly where it lands.
睡得這麼沉，連我走過來都沒發現。: Sleeping that soundly - it didn't even notice me walk up.
肚子還在鼓……不好，得找個能遮住的地方。: Its belly's still puffing up... not good, I need somewhere to take cover.
殼一層疊一層，連腳都快藏進去了。: Shell layered on shell - even its feet are almost tucked away.

長槍後面還有盾，這條路堵得真緊。: Shields behind the spears too - this road's really blocked tight.
別再唸了，我想不起招式了。: Stop chanting - I can't remember my own moves anymore.
影子在變淡。牠是想逃，還是想繞到我後面？: The shadow's fading. Is it trying to flee, or circle around behind me?
牠越瞪越兇。我連針都還沒拿出來呢。: Its glare keeps getting fiercer. I haven't even drawn my needle yet.
鱗粉飄過來了……還好我有戴口罩。: Scale dust is drifting this way... good thing I'm wearing a mask.
那隻手掌比我的頭還大。光看就覺得痛。: That palm is bigger than my head. Just looking at it hurts.
連池子旁邊都有人守，不能繞過去嗎？: Even the pond's edge is guarded - can't I just go around?
池水裡那些黑點，原來都是兵。: Those black dots in the pond water - they're all soldiers.
把頭縮進去了……這是在拒絕我嗎？: Pulled its head right in... is that a rejection?
牠一呼吸，鱗片就跟著動。原來真的有這麼大的貓。: Every breath it takes, the scales shift with it. So a cat really can get this big.
您在唸經，還是在咒我？: Are you reciting scripture, or cursing me?
牠按住刀柄了。我才剛走過來，還沒說話呢。: It just gripped the hilt. I only just walked over - I haven't even said anything yet.
曲子明明很好聽，背上卻一直發冷。: The tune's actually lovely, but my back won't stop shivering.
舌頭收回去啦，我看見了！: Tongue back in, I saw that!
聲音四面都有，到底是哪一個在響？: The sound's coming from everywhere - which one's actually making it?
你也替那位大人跑腿？這裡可不是玩耍的地方。: Running errands for that lord too? This is no place to play.
一隻鞋？另一隻呢……會不會從後面過來。: Just one shoe? Where's the other one... could it be coming from behind?
牠才從畫裡出來，就把地上滴得到處都是墨。: It just stepped out of the painting, and already the floor's covered in ink drips.
那是搗麻糬的杵吧？拜託別拿來搗我。: That's a mochi pounder, isn't it? Please don't pound me with it.
我繞到哪，牠就看到哪。連背後都躲不了。: Wherever I circle to, it sees. Can't even hide behind it.
紙邊這麼利……剛才差點就用手去接了。: The paper's edge is this sharp... I nearly caught it bare-handed just now.
那團霧一直朝這裡聚。裡面的臉，我不認得。: That mist keeps gathering this way. I don't recognize the face inside it.
剛才暗處那雙眼睛，原來離我這麼近。: Those eyes in the shadows just now - they were this close to me all along.
傘底下伸出一隻腳……我今天到底看到了什麼。: A leg poking out from under the umbrella... what have I even seen today.
你看的是袋子吧？裡面的小魚乾我還要留著。: You're eyeing the bag, aren't you? I still need that dried fish inside.
謝謝，可是這塊豆腐的味道不太對。: Thanks, but this tofu smells off.
扇子一動，我連站都站不住了。: One flick of the fan and I can't even stand.
牠一唸咒，我的毛就豎起來。: The moment it chants, my fur stands on end.
裡面是空的……到底是誰在讓這副盔甲動？: It's empty inside... so who's making this armor move?
師兄？……不對。那雙紫眼睛，跟那天晚上的師父一樣。: Big brother?... No. Those purple eyes - just like the Master that night.
那張臉明明是我，怎麼會自己笑起來？: That face is clearly mine - how is it smiling on its own?
你也要陪練？我沒答應一次兩個啊。: You're sparring too? I never agreed to take on two at once.
小魚乾堆得比牠還高……村裡卻都沒得吃。: The dried fish is piled higher than it is... and the village has none left to eat.
肩膀比門還寬。這一拳過來，我可接不住。: Shoulders wider than the doorway. One punch from that and I can't block it.
您別靠這麼近，酒味好重。: Please don't get this close - the liquor smell's overpowering.
她一抬下巴，後面就有人替她擋著。連話都不用說。: She just tips her chin, and someone shields her from behind. Doesn't even need to speak.
您把路擋得這麼緊，是誰叫您來的？: You've blocked the road this tight - who sent you here?
妳也得聽她的話，不能放我走嗎？: You have to obey her too? You can't just let me go?
那些小魚乾是從村裡拿來的吧？: That dried fish was taken from the village, wasn't it?
別滾到我腳邊，會絆倒的。: Don't roll near my feet - I'll trip.
衣服沾上這個，怎麼洗啊。: If this gets on my clothes, how would I ever wash it out?
裡面還有東西！我剛才差點坐下去。: There's something inside! I almost sat down on it.
師傅，您的刺掉了一地……我都不敢踩。: Master, your spines are all over the floor... I don't dare step anywhere.
罐頭裡又滿起來了。這裡面的東西吃不完嗎？: The can's full again. Is there no end to what's inside?
五隻爪子一起伸過來，我該看哪一隻？: Five claws reaching out at once - which one am I supposed to watch?
耳朵還在動……你其實沒睡著，對吧？: Your ears are still twitching... you're not actually asleep, are you?
那是我的小魚乾。還我。: That's my dried fish. Give it back.
這隻也在盯我的袋子。: This one's eyeing my bag too.
我歪頭，牠也歪頭。別連出招都照學呀。: I tilt my head, it tilts its head. Don't copy my moves too.
原來那不是掃把毛，是腳！難怪會往這邊爬。: So that's not broom bristles, it's legs! No wonder it's crawling this way.
村口那對石獅子，不會也這樣動吧？: Those stone lions at the village entrance - they won't start moving like this too, will they?
好熟悉的味道，可是聞久了頭好暈。: Such a familiar smell, but breathing it too long makes my head spin.
地上那個會轉的東西，怎麼衝著我來了？: That spinning thing on the ground - why's it coming right at me?
連掃把都來幫忙了？: Even the broom's here to help?
站了這麼久，連衣角都沒晃一下。: Standing that long, and not even a corner of the robe stirred.
牠貼著地面過來，我差點把腳伸進去了。: It's creeping along the ground - I nearly put my foot right in it.
旁邊兩隻也在動。不能只顧著眼前這一隻。: The two beside it are moving too. Can't just focus on the one in front.
牠一聲不響地守著我後面，反而最讓人不安。: The way it silently guards behind me is the most unsettling of all.
怎麼和家裡那根不一樣，推都推不動。: How's this different from the one back home - it won't budge no matter how I push.
婆婆，尾巴可以挪開一點嗎？我怕踩到。: Granny, could you move your tail a little? I'm afraid of stepping on it.
尾巴過來了，婆婆卻沒動！: The tail's coming this way, and Granny hasn't moved at all!
齒輪聲好刺耳。這麼多鐵爪，都是它在控制？: That gear noise is grating. All these iron claws - is it controlling them all?
這根本就是黃瓜……可是黃瓜為什麼在追我！: This is literally a cucumber... so why is a cucumber chasing me!
都長出臉了……再餓也不能當飯糰吃。: It's grown a face... no matter how hungry I am, I can't eat it like a rice ball.
原來這裡的木樁會自己找人練。: So the training stakes here find their own sparring partners.
你也迷路了嗎？……別低頭，角正對著我呢。: You got lost too?... Don't lower your head, those horns are pointed right at me.
關掉！拜託把那個聲音關掉！: Turn it off! Please, turn that sound off!
